native_resolution_supplement.purpose: re-read small overlays, chart text, and end-card text without the 960-wide reduction

manual_visual_review.finding: No account UI, private connection overlay, or course/certification/reward claim observed in these sampled composites.

limitations: Only 78 of 2340 video frames were sampled; transient content between sample points is not excluded.
960-wide OCR can miss fine text; only three representative samples received native-resolution supplemental OCR.
OCR remains probabilistic even at native resolution, especially for stylized, small, fading, or low-contrast text.
This verifies only the named silent composite at the recorded SHA256, not a later voiced render or altered export.
No external certification or reward entitlement was verified; only prohibited wording was searched.
